    1. DocumentIdReference(String, BeanIntrospection, Argument, B)

Class DocumentIdReference<B>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.serde.reference.PropertyReference<B,Object>
io.micronaut.serde.support.reference.DocumentIdReference<B>
Type Parameters:
B - The bean type
@Internal public final class DocumentIdReference<B> extends PropertyReference<B,Object>
A bean registered under, or looked up by, its document-scoped identifier. Pushed through PropertyReferenceManager.pushManagedRef(PropertyReference) to register the bean for the current document and passed to Deserializer.DecoderContext.resolveReference(PropertyReference) to look it up; the reference name is the identifier.
Since:
3.2
